dataset.name: WANDS Solr cores from Phase 6A/6B: wands_bench (quiet, 42994 docs), wands_bench_20x (noisy, 859880 docs)

engine_config.native: Apache Solr 9.10.1, one shared JVM, 2 cores, quiet tenant queried while 3 noisy threads hammer the other core

headline_result.h15_status: FALSIFIED, reproduced cleanly across 3 runs -- a genuine material effect, unlike H2's null result for pure query load in the native path
headline_result.self_caught_issue: first-draft (no warm-up) baseline p99 was unstable across runs (1.32x/2.04x/2.13x ratio) due to a JVM/connection-pool cold-start artifact inflating run 1's baseline reading (8.98ms vs 3.5-3.9ms in runs 2-3); fixed with a 500ms warm-up phase
headline_result.disclosed_unconfirmed_mechanism: Solr's own thread pool, JVM GC, and shared Lucene segment-merge/cache resources are genuinely shared across cores in one JVM -- not profiled or confirmed
headline_result.named_limitation: only 2 cores, one query type, one noisy-worker count tested; default out-of-the-box Solr configuration, no per-core resource isolation attempted
